name: browser-use
headline: thx-boris: Claude Code Building Methodology
short_description: Boris Cherny, creator of Claude Code, shows how he uses Claude Code to build Claude Code. This is a skill to package up that information.
author: saad-ahmed

sections.overview:
This skill packages Boris Cherny's approach to using Claude Code to build Claude Code itself. It provides insights into the development methodology and practices of Claude Code's creator, documented in his public sharing of the development process. The skill is designed for developers interested in understanding how Claude Code is built and the workflows that power its development. It captures the specific techniques and strategies Cherny uses when working with Claude Code as both creator and user.
Understanding Claude Code development practices
Learning from the creator's own workflow methodology
Studying self-referential AI tool development
Adopting proven Claude Code usage patterns
